description_target.target_text: Use the example input/output panels to infer two things: which geometric transform was applied to the shape support, and how colors were remapped after the transform. Apply the same transform to the query panel and then recolor each transformed cell using the learned color mapping.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define dirs4 (list (list -1 0) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1) (list 0 1)))
    (define dirs8 (list (list -1 0) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1) (list 0 1)
                        (list -1 -1) (list -1 1) (list 1 -1) (list 1 1)))
    (define (cell< a b)
      (if (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)) (< (first a) (first b))))
    (define (obj-r1 obj) (first (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (obj-c1 obj) (second (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (obj-r2 obj) (third (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (obj-c2 obj) (fourth (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (paint grid cells color)
      (for/fold ([out grid]) ([p (in-list cells)])
        (if (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) (rows out) (cols out))
            (set-cell out (first p) (second p) color)
            out)))
    (define (clear-cells grid cells)
      (for/fold ([out grid]) ([p (in-list cells)])
        (set-cell out (first p) (second p) 0)))
    (define (nonzero-cells grid)
      (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) 0))) (grid-positions grid)))
    (define (without-colors grid colors)
      (grid-from-fn (rows grid) (cols grid)
        (lambda (r c) (if (member? (at grid r c) colors) 0 (at grid r c)))))
    (define (component-grid obj)
      (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
             (h (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb))))
             (w (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb)))))
        (for/fold ([out (empty-grid h w 0)]) ([p (in-list (obj-cells obj))])
          (set-cell out (- (first p) (first bb)) (- (second p) (second bb)) (obj-color obj)))))
    (define (crop-nonzero grid)
      (let ((cells (nonzero-cells grid)))
        (if (empty? cells)
            (list (list 0))
            (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
              (subgrid grid (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb))))))
    (define (binary-grid grid)
      (grid-from-fn (rows grid) (cols grid) (lambda (r c) (if (= (at grid r c) 0) 0 1))))
    (define (normalize-binary grid) (binary-grid (crop-nonzero grid)))
    (define (paste-crop grid shape top left)
      (for*/fold ([out grid]) ([r (in-range (rows shape))] [c (in-range (cols shape))])
        (let ((v (at shape r c)) (rr (+ top r)) (cc (+ left c)))
          (if (and (not (= v 0)) (in-bounds? rr cc (rows out) (cols out)))
              (set-cell out rr cc v)
              out))))
    (define (pad-grid grid h w)
      (paste-crop (empty-grid h w 0) grid 0 0))
    (define (normalize-pair a b)
      (let* ((aa (crop-nonzero a))
             (bb (crop-nonzero b))
             (h (max (rows aa) (rows bb)))
             (w (max (cols aa) (cols bb))))
        (list (pad-grid aa h w) (pad-grid bb h w))))
    (define (shape-variants shape)
      (let* ((r0 shape)
             (r1 (rotate-cw r0))
             (r2 (rotate-cw r1))
             (r3 (rotate-cw r2))
             (vars (list r0 (flip-lr r0) r1 (flip-lr r1) r2 (flip-lr r2) r3 (flip-lr r3))))
        (let loop ([xs vars] [seen (list)] [acc (list)])
          (if (empty? xs)
              (reverse acc)
              (let ((sig (normalize-binary (first xs))))
                (if (member? sig seen)
                    (loop (rest xs) seen acc)
                    (loop (rest xs) (cons sig seen) (cons (first xs) acc))))))))
    (define (contour-cells obj)
      (filter
       (lambda (p)
         (any? (lambda (d)
                 (not (member? (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d))) (obj-cells obj))))
               dirs4))
       (obj-cells obj)))
    (define (contour-shape obj)
      (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
             (h (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb))))
             (w (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb)))))
        (paint (empty-grid h w 0)
               (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (first bb)) (- (second p) (second bb)))) (contour-cells obj))
               (obj-color obj))))
    (define (shape-boolean a b op color)
      (let* ((pair (normalize-pair a b))
             (aa (first pair))
             (bb (second pair))
             (raw
              (grid-from-fn (rows aa) (cols aa)
                (lambda (r c)
                  (let* ((av (not (= (at aa r c) 0)))
                         (bv (not (= (at bb r c) 0)))
                         (keep (cond [(equal? op 'union) (or av bv)]
                                     [(equal? op 'intersection) (and av bv)]
                                     [(equal? op 'xor) (not (equal? av bv))]
                                     [(equal? op 'a-minus-b) (and av (not bv))]
                                     [(equal? op 'b-minus-a) (and bv (not av))]
                                     [else #f])))
                    (if keep color 0))))))
        (crop-nonzero raw)))
    (define (pack-gallery shapes gap)
      (let* ((cropped (map crop-nonzero shapes))
             (h (apply max (map rows cropped)))
             (w (+ (apply + (map cols cropped)) (* gap (max 0 (- (length cropped) 1))))))
        (let loop ([xs cropped] [left 0] [out (empty-grid h w 0)])
          (if (empty? xs)
              out
              (loop (rest xs) (+ left (cols (first xs)) gap) (paste-crop out (first xs) 0 left))))))
    (define (row-signature shape)
      (map (lambda (row) (length (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) row))) (crop-nonzero shape)))
    (define (slide-cells grid cells dr dc blockers)
      (let loop ([cur cells])
        (let ((nxt (translate-cells cur dr dc)))
          (if (and (all? (lambda (p) (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) (rows grid) (cols grid))) nxt)
                   (not (any? (lambda (p) (member? p blockers)) nxt)))
              (loop nxt)
              cur))))
    (define (blocker-cells grid)
      (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) 0))) (grid-positions grid)))
    (define (geo-distance grid start target walls)
      (let bfs ([queue (list (list start 0))] [seen (list start)] [fuel (* (rows grid) (cols grid) 4)])
        (cond [(<= fuel 0) 9999]
              [(empty? queue) 9999]
              [(equal? (first (first queue)) target) (second (first queue))]
              [else
               (let* ((item (first queue))
                      (cell (first item))
                      (dist (second item))
                      (nbrs (filter
                             (lambda (p)
                               (and (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) (rows grid) (cols grid))
                                    (not (member? p walls))
                                    (not (member? p seen))))
                             (map (lambda (d) (list (+ (first cell) (first d)) (+ (second cell) (second d)))) dirs4))))
                 (bfs (append (rest queue) (map (lambda (p) (list p (+ dist 1))) nbrs))
                      (append seen nbrs)
                      (- fuel 1)))])))
    (define (rotate-about cells pivot turns)
      (map
       (lambda (p)
         (let* ((y (- (first p) (first pivot)))
                (x (- (second p) (second pivot)))
                (k (modulo turns 4))
                (ny (cond [(= k 0) y] [(= k 1) x] [(= k 2) (- y)] [else (- x)]))
                (nx (cond [(= k 0) x] [(= k 1) (- y)] [(= k 2) (- x)] [else y])))
           (list (+ (first pivot) ny) (+ (second pivot) nx))))
       cells))

    (define (fifth xs) (list-ref xs 4))
    (define (split-panels-row grid count)
      (let* ((panel-w (quotient (- (cols grid) (- count 1)) count)))
        (for/list ([i (in-range count)])
          (let ((left (* i (+ panel-w 1))))
            (subgrid grid 0 left (- (rows grid) 1) (+ left panel-w -1))))))
    (define transform-names (list 'id 'rot90 'rot180 'rot270 'flip-h 'flip-v 'transpose 'anti-transpose))
    (define (anti-transpose-grid grid) (rotate-180 (transpose grid)))
    (define (apply-transform-name name grid)
      (cond [(equal? name 'id) grid]
            [(equal? name 'rot90) (rotate-cw grid)]
            [(equal? name 'rot180) (rotate-180 grid)]
            [(equal? name 'rot270) (rotate-ccw grid)]
            [(equal? name 'flip-h) (flip-lr grid)]
            [(equal? name 'flip-v) (flip-ud grid)]
            [(equal? name 'transpose) (transpose grid)]
            [else (anti-transpose-grid grid)]))
    (define (infer-transform-name a b)
      (first (filter (lambda (name) (equal? (apply-transform-name name a) b)) transform-names)))
    (define (merge-op a b)
      (grid-from-fn (rows a) (cols a)
        (lambda (r c)
          (let ((x (at a r c)) (y (at b r c)))
            (cond [(and (= x 0) (= y 0)) 0]
                  [(= x 0) y]
                  [(= y 0) x]
                  [(= x y) x]
                  [else 9])))))
    (define (op-intersection-eq a b)
      (grid-from-fn (rows a) (cols a)
        (lambda (r c)
          (let ((x (at a r c)) (y (at b r c)))
            (if (and (not (= x 0)) (= x y)) x 0)))))
    (define (op-xor a b)
      (grid-from-fn (rows a) (cols a)
        (lambda (r c)
          (let ((x (at a r c)) (y (at b r c)))
            (cond [(and (not (= x 0)) (= y 0)) x]
                  [(and (= x 0) (not (= y 0))) y]
                  [else 0])))))
    (define (op-left-minus a b)
      (grid-from-fn (rows a) (cols a)
        (lambda (r c) (if (and (not (= (at a r c) 0)) (= (at b r c) 0)) (at a r c) 0))))
    (define op-names (list 'intersection-eq 'xor 'left-minus 'conflict-merge))
    (define (apply-op name a b)
      (cond [(equal? name 'intersection-eq) (op-intersection-eq a b)]
            [(equal? name 'xor) (op-xor a b)]
            [(equal? name 'left-minus) (op-left-minus a b)]
            [else (merge-op a b)]))
    (define (infer-op-name a b result)
      (first (filter (lambda (name) (equal? (apply-op name a b) result)) op-names)))
    (define (crop-cells grid cells)
      (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
        (subgrid grid (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb))))
    (define (canonical-cells panel)
      (sort (normalize-cells
             (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at panel (first p) (second p)) 0))) (grid-positions panel)))
            cell<))
    (define (components-any-nonzero grid)
      (let loop-pos ([positions (grid-positions grid)] [seen (list)] [acc (list)])
        (cond [(empty? positions) (reverse acc)]
              [(or (member? (first positions) seen)
                   (= (at grid (first (first positions)) (second (first positions))) 0))
               (loop-pos (rest positions) seen acc)]
              [else
               (let bfs ([queue (list (first positions))] [seen2 (cons (first positions) seen)] [cells (list)])
                 (if (empty? queue)
                     (loop-pos (rest positions) seen2 (cons (sort cells cell<) acc))
                     (let* ((cur (first queue))
                            (nbrs (filter
                                   (lambda (p)
                                     (and (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) (rows grid) (cols grid))
                                          (not (member? p seen2))
                                          (not (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) 0))))
                                   (map (lambda (d) (list (+ (first cur) (first d)) (+ (second cur) (second d)))) dirs4))))
                       (bfs (append (rest queue) nbrs) (append seen2 nbrs) (cons cur cells)))))])))
    (define (regions-without-wall grid wall-color)
      (let loop-pos ([positions (grid-positions grid)] [seen (list)] [acc (list)])
        (cond [(empty? positions) (reverse acc)]
              [(or (member? (first positions) seen)
                   (= (at grid (first (first positions)) (second (first positions))) wall-color))
               (loop-pos (rest positions) seen acc)]
              [else
               (let bfs ([queue (list (first positions))] [seen2 (cons (first positions) seen)] [cells (list)])
                 (if (empty? queue)
                     (loop-pos (rest positions) seen2 (cons (sort cells cell<) acc))
                     (let* ((cur (first queue))
                            (nbrs (filter
                                   (lambda (p)
                                     (and (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) (rows grid) (cols grid))
                                          (not (member? p seen2))
                                          (not (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) wall-color))))
                                   (map (lambda (d) (list (+ (first cur) (first d)) (+ (second cur) (second d)))) dirs4))))
                       (bfs (append (rest queue) nbrs) (append seen2 nbrs) (cons cur cells)))))])))
    (define (room-seed-colors grid cells)
      (remove-duplicates
       (filter (lambda (v) (not (member? v (list 0 5))))
               (map (lambda (p) (at grid (first p) (second p))) cells))))
    (define (shape-dims cells)
      (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
        (list (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb))) (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb))))))

    (define (scale2-grid grid)
      (apply append
        (for/list ([row (in-list grid)])
          (let ((expanded (apply append (map (lambda (v) (list v v)) row))))
            (list expanded expanded)))))
    (define (component-grid-cells grid cells)
      (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
             (h (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb))))
             (w (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb)))))
        (for/fold ([out (empty-grid h w 0)]) ([p (in-list cells)])
          (set-cell out (- (first p) (first bb)) (- (second p) (second bb)) (at grid (first p) (second p))))))
    (define (split-fixed-panels-row grid panel-h panel-w)
      (let loop ([c 0] [acc (list)])
        (if (> (+ c panel-w) (cols grid))
            (reverse acc)
            (loop (+ c panel-w 1)
                  (cons (subgrid grid 0 c (- panel-h 1) (+ c panel-w -1)) acc)))))
    (define (panelize-row panels sep)
      (let* ((h (rows (first panels)))
             (w (+ (apply + (map cols panels)) (* sep (max 0 (- (length panels) 1))))))
        (let loop ([xs panels] [left 0] [out (empty-grid h w 0)])
          (if (empty? xs)
              out
              (loop (rest xs) (+ left (cols (first xs)) sep) (paste-crop out (first xs) 0 left))))))
    (define (gallery-grid panel-rows sep)
      (let* ((ph (rows (first (first panel-rows))))
             (pw (cols (first (first panel-rows))))
             (nr (length panel-rows))
             (nc (length (first panel-rows)))
             (out-h (+ (* nr ph) (* sep (max 0 (- nr 1)))))
             (out-w (+ (* nc pw) (* sep (max 0 (- nc 1))))))
        (for*/fold ([out (empty-grid out-h out-w 0)])
                   ([ri (in-range nr)] [ci (in-range nc)])
          (paste-crop out (list-ref (list-ref panel-rows ri) ci) (* ri (+ ph sep)) (* ci (+ pw sep))))))
    (define (xor-panels a b color)
      (grid-from-fn (rows a) (cols a)
        (lambda (r c)
          (let ((av (not (= (at a r c) 0))) (bv (not (= (at b r c) 0))))
            (if (not (equal? av bv)) color 0)))))
    (define (sgn x) (cond [(> x 0) 1] [(< x 0) -1] [else 0]))
    (define (transform-by-code grid code)
      (cond [(= code 1) grid]
            [(= code 2) (rotate-cw grid)]
            [(= code 3) (flip-lr grid)]
            [(= code 4) (flip-ud grid)]
            [else grid]))
    (define (count-stamp counts obj top left)
      (for*/fold ([out counts]) ([r (in-range (rows obj))] [c (in-range (cols obj))])
        (let ((v (at obj r c)) (rr (+ top r)) (cc (+ left c)))
          (if (and (not (= v 0)) (in-bounds? rr cc (rows out) (cols out)))
              (set-cell out rr cc (+ 1 (at out rr cc)))
              out))))
    (define (regions-without-wall-skip grid wall-color skip-row)
      (let loop-pos ([positions (filter (lambda (p) (>= (first p) skip-row)) (grid-positions grid))]
                     [seen (list)]
                     [acc (list)])
        (cond [(empty? positions) (reverse acc)]
              [(or (member? (first positions) seen)
                   (= (at grid (first (first positions)) (second (first positions))) wall-color))
               (loop-pos (rest positions) seen acc)]
              [else
               (let bfs ([queue (list (first positions))] [seen2 (cons (first positions) seen)] [cells (list)])
                 (if (empty? queue)
                     (loop-pos (rest positions) seen2 (cons (sort cells cell<) acc))
                     (let* ((cur (first queue))
                            (nbrs (filter
                                   (lambda (p)
                                     (and (>= (first p) skip-row)
                                          (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) (rows grid) (cols grid))
                                          (not (member? p seen2))
                                          (not (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) wall-color))))
                                   (map (lambda (d) (list (+ (first cur) (first d)) (+ (second cur) (second d)))) dirs4))))
                       (bfs (append (rest queue) nbrs) (append seen2 nbrs) (cons cur cells)))))])))
    (define (between-inclusive a b)
      (if (<= a b) (range a (+ b 1)) (reverse (range b (+ a 1)))))
    (define (clear-elbow-segment? grid pts a b)
      (let ((ra (first a)) (ca (second a)) (rb (first b)) (cb (second b)))
        (cond [(= ra rb)
               (all? (lambda (c) (or (member? (list ra c) pts) (= (at grid ra c) 0)))
                     (between-inclusive ca cb))]
              [(= ca cb)
               (all? (lambda (r) (or (member? (list r ca) pts) (= (at grid r ca) 0)))
                     (between-inclusive ra rb))]
              [else #f])))

    (define (first-nonzero grids)
      (let ((vals (apply append (map (lambda (grid) (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (apply append grid))) grids))))
        (if (empty? vals) 0 (first vals))))
    (define (support-of grid) (canonical-cells grid))
    (define (support->grid cells color)
      (if (empty? cells)
          (list (list 0))
          (let* ((dims (shape-dims cells))
                 (h (first dims))
                 (w (second dims)))
            (paint (empty-grid h w 0) cells color))))
    (define (apply-support-op name a b)
      (grid-from-fn (rows a) (cols a)
        (lambda (r c)
          (let ((av (not (= (at a r c) 0))) (bv (not (= (at b r c) 0))))
            (cond [(equal? name 'union) (if (or av bv) 1 0)]
                  [(equal? name 'intersection) (if (and av bv) 1 0)]
                  [else (if (not (equal? av bv)) 1 0)])))))
    (define support-op-names (list 'union 'intersection 'xor))
    (define (infer-support-op a b result)
      (let ((aa (binary-grid a)) (bb (binary-grid b)) (rr (binary-grid result)))
        (first (filter (lambda (name) (equal? (apply-support-op name aa bb) rr)) support-op-names))))
    (define (pack-pieces pieces)
      (if (empty? pieces)
          (list (list 0))
          (let* ((h (apply max (map rows pieces)))
                 (w (+ (apply + (map cols pieces)) (max 0 (- (length pieces) 1)))))
            (let loop ([xs pieces] [left 0] [out (empty-grid h w 0)])
              (if (empty? xs)
                  out
                  (loop (rest xs) (+ left (cols (first xs)) 1) (paste-crop out (first xs) 0 left)))))))
    (define (recolor-grid grid color)
      (grid-from-fn (rows grid) (cols grid)
        (lambda (r c) (if (= (at grid r c) 0) 0 color))))
    (define (bbox-center cells)
      (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
        (list (quotient (+ (first bb) (third bb)) 2)
              (quotient (+ (second bb) (fourth bb)) 2))))
    (define (axis-col-8 grid)
      (first (filter (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (= (at grid r c) 8)) (range (rows grid)))) (range (cols grid)))))
    (define (transform-support-name name grid)
      (support-of (apply-transform-name name (binary-grid grid))))
    (define (infer-support-transform a b)
      (let ((target (support-of b)))
        (first (filter (lambda (name) (equal? (transform-support-name name a) target)) transform-names))))
    (define (infer-support-transform-exact a b)
      (let ((target (binary-grid b)))
        (first (filter (lambda (name) (equal? (apply-transform-name name (binary-grid a)) target)) transform-names))))

    (let* ((panels (split-panels-row g 3))
           (ex-in (first panels)) (ex-out (second panels)) (query (third panels))
           (name (infer-support-transform-exact ex-in ex-out))
           (tq (apply-transform-name name query))
           (tex (apply-transform-name name ex-in))
           (mapping (filter values
                            (for*/list ([r (in-range (rows ex-out))] [c (in-range (cols ex-out))])
                              (let ((a (at tex r c)) (b (at ex-out r c)))
                                (if (and (not (= a 0)) (not (= b 0))) (list a b) #f))))))
      (grid-from-fn (rows tq) (cols tq)
        (lambda (r c)
          (let* ((v (at tq r c))
                 (hit (filter (lambda (p) (= (first p) v)) mapping)))
            (if (and (not (= v 0)) (not (empty? hit))) (second (first hit)) v)))))
  ))
